observations.observed_outcome: The unrecoverable older binary was not substituted or used to invalidate its historical runs. A bounded new artifact qualification was admitted. A separately authorized real Cycle 006 later made one model invocation/task transmission and terminalized at A1_CANDIDATE_INDEPENDENCE_NOT_PASS with no retry/replacement; lower predicates and output content remain unestablished. Stage D subsequently reported custody re-verification and promoted a narrow residue into FN125 after protected-root regression blocked its first placement. PR131 reports its repaired full suite passed. Neither qualification nor promotion establishes whole-flow success or current runtime availability.

assessment.implication: When exact rerun identity matters, inspect current custody and claim scope; missing historical bytes require HOLD on the dependent operation or separately authorized forward qualification, not silent substitution. For promotion, use an existing permissible reference instead of weakening a protected artifact. A qualification PASS and later rule promotion do not erase the real A1 stop or authorize a retry; preserve the unknown lower cause.
assessment.causal_limit: One connected migration history with a later real one-attempt stop and a promotion, not three independent successes. Stage D used a deterministic local reader; fixture tests and no-turn protocol checks are separate from the real Cycle006 invocation. Private underlying execution records were not replayed; the A1 result is not evidence that the runtime migration caused the failure.
